### Agenus to Participate in Chardan’s 10th Annual Healthcare Investor Conference


October 9, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s202.q4cdn.com/949764554/files/doc_news/Agenus-to-Participate-in-Chardans-10th-Annual-Healthcare-Investor-Conference-2026.pdf)


LEXINGTON, Mass.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Agenus](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.agenusbio.com&esheet=54619301&newsitemid=20261009464799&lan=en-US&anchor=Agenus&index=1&md5=bd60563079f4398ecf3e9a66ee9f66a2) **Inc. (Nasdaq: AGEN)** , a leader in immuno-oncology innovation, today announced that Zack Armen, Head of Corporate Development and Investor Relations, will participate in a fireside chat and one-on-one investor meetings at Chardan’s 10th Annual Healthcare Conference: The Next 10 Years of Disruptive Innovation, on October 20, 2026.


**Chardan 10th Annual Healthcare Conference: The Next 10 Years of Disruptive Innovation**


- **Date:** Tuesday, October 20, 2026
- **Location** : Lotte New York Palace, New York, NY
- **Fireside Chat:** Tuesday, October 20, 2026 | 11:00am ET
- **Webcast Link:**[https://bit.ly/4yPWgp1](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fbit.ly%2F4yPWgp1&esheet=54619301&newsitemid=20261009464799&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fbit.ly%2F4yPWgp1&index=2&md5=72e4a45055cce420114aeee6f89dbfb3)


An archived recording of the fireside chat will be available for 30 days following the event and will be available as a replay on the Events & Presentations section of the Agenus investor relations website at[Agenus Inc. - Events](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.agenusbio.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54619301&newsitemid=20261009464799&lan=en-US&anchor=Agenus+Inc.+-+Events&index=3&md5=c159c7922af5161dcfac88a9d2753754) .


**About Agenus**


Agenus is a leading immuno-oncology company targeting cancer with a comprehensive pipeline of immunological agents. The company was founded in 1994 with a mission to expand patient populations benefiting from cancer immunotherapy through combination approaches, using a broad repertoire of antibody therapeutics, adoptive cell therapies (through MiNK Therapeutics) and adjuvants. Agenus has robust end-to-end development capabilities, across commercial and clinical cGMP manufacturing facilities, research and discovery, and a global clinical operations footprint. Agenus is headquartered in Lexington, MA. For more information, visit[www.agenusbio.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.agenusbio.com&esheet=54619301&newsitemid=20261009464799&lan=en-US&anchor=www.agenusbio.com&index=4&md5=81ffb1a05492a24e9c9353525781addb) or @agenus_bio. Information that may be important to investors will be routinely posted on our website and social media channels.
